info.label: How Quorum works
info.title: How Quorum works
info.step1: Everyone answers privately — budget, food, getting there, when you're free, and hard no's.
info.step2: Grok finds 2–3 plans that fit everyone (budgets and hard no's stay hidden).
info.step3: You each vote "I'm in" from your own phone. Most votes wins.
info.step4: The winner shows up as a poster plus a calendar file you can save.
info.privacyBody: Nobody in the group sees your budget or hard no's. Only Grok reads them to find a plan that fits.
